profile.headline: SWE @ Bank of America | NYU Alumna | Rewriting the Code affiliate | Avid Baker
profile.summary:
Hi there! I'm Cheyenne, a rising senior at New York University, where I'm majoring in Computer Science and minoring in Applied Mathematics. Expected to graduate in May 2025, I'm passionate about learning and eager to showcase my skills and capabilities.

Beyond my academic pursuits, I'm deeply interested in creativity. I love to crochet, cook, and bake, finding joy in bringing imaginative ideas to life through these hobbies. This creative spirit fuels my approach to problem-solving and innovation in my studies and projects.

I'm driven by a desire to make a meaningful impact in the world. With a strong foundation in chemistry, physics, mathematics, and programming, I'm excited to tackle real-world problems and address the pressing challenges facing society today and share a few recipes along the way!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Teaching Assistant for General Engineering program
positions.locationName: Brooklyn, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description: As a Teacher's Assistant in NYU's General Engineering program, I support instructors in delivering engaging and effective lessons to students involving technical writing, public speaking, and project management. I assist with course materials, facilitate group activities, and provide individualized support to students to ensure they have a successful learning experience. I am passionate about education and eager to contribute to the growth and success of future engineers.

positions.title: Enterprise Architect Data Scientist
positions.description:
As a Data Scientist Intern at GE Aerospace, I dive deep into the data to uncover the root causes of quality assurance escapes, leveraging advanced database management tools to reveal crucial insights. One of my key achievements has been developing a dynamic dashboard that provides a clear comparison of site-specific data against industry standards, ensuring we maintain at least a 50% match percentage.

Collaboration is at the heart of my role. Working closely with cross-functional teams, I ensure that our data is accurate and relevant, enabling effective and insightful reporting. This collaborative approach not only enhances data quality but also drives meaningful improvements in our quality assurance processes.
positions.insights: Skills: Oracle SQL Developer · Amazon Redshift · Data Science · Database Development · Spotfire · Documentation Research

positions.title: Full-Stack Mentee
positions.description: During my experience at Qualtrics, I dedicated myself to hands-on full-stack development, focusing on personal growth through mentorship. I actively participated in workshops to refine my problem-solving skills, particularly in optimizing user experiences. Collaborating closely with diverse mentees, I developed effective communication and interpersonal skills, contributing to my comprehensive development in full-stack technologies.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · React.js · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Tailwind CSS

positions.title: Special Project Coordinator (Artificial Intelligence for Scientific Research)
positions.locationName: Brooklyn, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description: As a Coordinator for the a subteam in a Vertically Integrated Project dedicated to bringing artificial intelligence to scientific labs and processes, I play a crucial role in ensuring the successful implementation of AI in various scientific fields. My responsibilities include overseeing a group of interdisciplinary students and working with them to develop innovative solutions to tedious scientific processes
positions.insights: Skills: Overseeing Projects · Scientific Writing · Research and Development (R&D) · Project Coordination

positions.title: Retail Cashier
positions.locationName: Wayne, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description: I am a dedicated and efficient cashier at Target, where I excel in providing exceptional customer service and accurately processing transactions. With my strong attention to detail and ability to multitask, I am able to handle busy checkout lines with ease. I am committed to creating a positive shopping experience for each and every customer, and I take pride in being a friendly and reliable member of the Target team.

positions.title: Retail Specialist
positions.description: As a Cashier and Retail Associate at Footlocker, I have honed my customer service and sales skills, providing a positive shopping experience for customers and effectively assisting with product inquiries and purchases. I am skilled in handling cash transactions, processing returns, and maintaining store organization.
positions.insights: Skills: Sales · Customer Service · Retail Sales · Communication

volunteerExperiences.role: Professional Chair and Interchapter Relations Chair

organizations.name: Alpha Omega Epsilon
organizations.position: Interchapter Relations and Professional Chair · Mar 2022 - Present
organizations.description: I held the position of interchapter-relations chair in my sorority of Alpha Omega Epsilon, as well as Professional Chair, and in this position I am in charge of managing conversations and planning events that involve different chapters from different states that build our member's professional standings entering into the workforce. With this position comes being able to manage myself and be able to to communicate with individuals from different backgrounds in STEM related fields and find the best processes to achieve the objectives and expectations we attempt to meet.

organizations.name: National Society of Black Engineers
organizations.description: As a member of the National Society of Black Engineers (NSBE), I am actively engaged in promoting diversity and inclusion in STEM fields, developing leadership skills among other African American collaborators, and being supported as member of underrepresented communities.
